name: root-crate-plan-cmd-project-cmd-split
body: The `plan_cmd` module is organized as `src/plan_cmd/envelope.rs`, `src/plan_cmd/authoring.rs`, `src/plan_cmd/status.rs`, `src/plan_cmd/verify.rs`, and `src/plan_cmd/render.rs`; the `project_cmd` module is organized as `src/project_cmd/start.rs`, `src/project_cmd/merge.rs`, and `src/project_cmd/delete.rs`. `rust.apg.plan_cmd.cmd_plan` and `rust.apg.project_cmd.cmd_project` are the module commands, and `rust.apg.project_cmd.require_apg_root`, `rust.apg.project_cmd.validate_project_name`, and `rust.apg.project_cmd.worktree_hosting` live in `src/project_cmd/mod.rs`. `solution.component.project-start-seeder` is implemented-by `rust.apg.project_cmd.start.project_start`, `rust.apg.project_cmd.start.project_start_at`, and `rust.apg.project_cmd.start.copy_trans_artifacts`.
